# Copilot Instructions for Documentations and Unit Tests

### Documentation

When generating documentation for code, please follow these guidelines:

Write english documentation that is clear, concise, and easy to understand.

For files, provide a brief overview of the file's purpose at the top.
For classes, include a description of the class's role and its main attributes.
For functions and methods, describe their purpose, parameters, return values, and any exceptions they may raise.
